clue.text: Joint excavation causing row

parts.note: the shin is the front of the leg, read loosely as a joint
a dig is an archaeological excavation

explanation.surface: A shared archaeological project causes an argument among the diggers.
explanation.definitionFit: Informally a noisy party or a commotion, hence a rumpus or row.

clue.text: Internationals flank representative group of armed warriors

indicators.note: the two letters stand either side of the other piece, as troops flank a position

parts.note: I is the abbreviation for international, so two of them give two Is
an MP is a Member of Parliament, an elected representative

explanation.surface: Players from abroad stand alongside a delegate in some team photo.
explanation.definitionFit: A Zulu regiment or band of warriors, the term used in southern Africa.

clue.text: Steal feature of Quidditch

definitions.meaning: informal verb meaning to pilfer or pinch
the Golden ball chased by Seekers in the Harry Potter wizard sport

explanation.surface: Pinching the prized ball in the Harry Potter game.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang verb for pilfer, and the name of the winged ball in J K Rowling's invented sport.

clue.text: Getting together outfit about new ring

indicators.note: the outfit word goes round the abbreviation for new

parts.note: a kit is a set of clothing, an outfit
a ting is a light ringing sound

explanation.surface: Getting dressed up around a newly bought ring, perhaps for an engagement.
explanation.definitionFit: Joining or uniting, as broken bones mend; also the craft of making fabric from yarn.

clue.text: Trouble with gum is giving it when swimming

indicators.note: the words are set swimming about, so their letters get mixed up

explanation.surface: Chewing gum while swimming gives a problem, in a playful picture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gum' looks like chewing gum, but means the flesh round the teeth.
explanation.definitionFit: Inflammation of the gums, a dental ailment.

clue.text: Attractive pub in part of building

indicators.note: the pub word sits inside the building word

parts.note: a wing is a section projecting from a main building
an inn is a public house

explanation.surface: An appealing bar housed in one section of a large building.
explanation.definitionFit: Charming or engaging, as in a disarming smile.

clue.text: According life-force to dynasty

parts.note: chi (qi) is the Chinese vital energy
the Ming dynasty ruled China 1368-1644

explanation.surface: Granting vital energy to a royal house of China.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in harmony or agreeing, as in fitting in with something said.

clue.text: Restrict popular success about black independence

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular

indicators.note: the success word wraps round the next two letters

parts.note: a hit is a success
B is the pencil-grade abbreviation for black
I is an abbreviation for independence or independent

explanation.surface: Curbing a famous triumph concerning black self-rule, a political-sounding sentence.
explanation.definitionFit: To hold back or prevent, a synonym of restrain.

clue.text: Possibly printing one is cheerfully encouraging

indicators.note: signals the letters might be arranged some other way

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: Seeing your work in print can be a boost to a writer.
explanation.definitionFit: Raising the spirits, so heartening and uplifting.

clue.text: In Hell colour is faint

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld and so the underworld itself
a tinct is a tint or colour (archaic)

explanation.surface: In the underworld everything is pale, a gothic picture.
explanation.definitionFit: Not clearly perceived, so dim or vague.

clue.text: In the beginning were spirits

indicators.note: the word 'In' says the letters are found inside the following word

explanation.surface: A Genesis-style opening: in the beginning there were spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: Plural of jinni, the genies or spirits of Arabian lore.

clue.text: Royal rank is trendy after one's relatives start to govern

indicators.note: the trendy word comes after the rest

parts.note: kin means one's family members

indicators.note: the start of the word govern gives its first letter

parts.note: the possessive ending supplies an S
hip means fashionable

explanation.surface: A monarch's status depends on family members beginning to rule.
explanation.definitionFit: The position, office or dignity of a monarch.

clue.text: Sorrow not ecstasy at end as chimera

indicators.note: the drug word is left out of the sorrow word

parts.note: grief means deep sorrow
E is slang for the drug ecstasy
finish means end

explanation.surface: Grief without euphoria at last turns into a monster.
explanation.definitionFit: Resembling a mythical beast with lion's body and eagle's head, a composite creature like a chimera.

clue.text: This Berlin, eg, could be grieving

indicators.note: says the letters of the clue word may be rearranged into the answer plus the letters of eg

explanation.surface: A songwriter's name could hide grief.
explanation.walkthrough: A composite: the answer with E and G added, rearranged, makes 'grieving'.
explanation.definitionFit: Forename of Irving Berlin, the American songwriter.

clue.text: Philosopher with legal claims for specialist builders

parts.note: John Stuart Mill, the English philosopher
rights are entitlements in law

explanation.surface: A thinker teams up with property titles to commission construction.
explanation.definitionFit: Engineers who design and build mills and their machinery.

clue.text: Long distance badge for one essential

parts.note: an inch is a small distance
a pin is a lapel badge

explanation.surface: A medal for covering a great distance, such as a marathon.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone or something indispensable, the vital central piece.

clue.text: Marvellous commune provided one reaches 100

parts.note: a mir is a Russian peasant commune
if means provided that
I is the Roman numeral one
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: A community would be wonderful if someone lived to a hundred.
explanation.definitionFit: Archaic word for wonder-working or wonderful.

clue.text: Proper accessory

explanation.surface: A correct add-on, the right attachment for the job.
explanation.definitionFit: Adjective for appropriate, and a noun for a small attached part or fixture.

clue.text: Row during lunch

parts.note: a tiff is a petty quarrel
in means during, as in 'in the morning'

explanation.surface: An argument breaks out over the midday meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Anglo-Indian word for a light midday meal.

clue.text: Condition of identity for cat?

definitions.meaning: the state of being one of a matched pair, identical
a catamaran, nicknamed cat, is a vessel with two hulls, read as a doubled ship

explanation.surface: Asking what state of being identical a cat would have.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cat' is the sailing catamaran, not the animal: a twin-hulled boat.
explanation.definitionFit: The state of being a twin, and humorously a twin-hulled vessel.

clue.text: Drop in this month with the Italian

parts.note: inst. (instant) is a business abbreviation for this month
il is Italian for the

explanation.surface: Visit this month along with the Italian.
explanation.definitionFit: To introduce drop by drop, hence gradually impart.

clue.text: Dry two-thirds of jar

indicators.note: only the first four of the six letters are kept

parts.note: a Kilner jar is a glass preserving jar

explanation.surface: Drain most of the jar.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb, to bake or dry in an oven for pottery or hops.

clue.text: Deer spots direction-finders at rear

parts.note: a hind is a female red deer
sights means spots or catches sight of

explanation.surface: A doe notices some aiming devices on a gun.
explanation.definitionFit: Rear sights on a gun barrel, used to aim at a target.

clue.text: Traps river eel on its way back

indicators.note: the eel is swimming back, so its word is read backwards

parts.note: a snig is a young or small eel

explanation.surface: Snares an eel returning upstream.
explanation.definitionFit: Snares or nets for catching game.

clue.text: Children with affinity for soft leather

parts.note: kids are children
kin as relation by blood or marriage, an affinity

explanation.surface: Youngsters have a fondness for supple hide.
explanation.definitionFit: Leather made from the skin of a young goat.

clue.text: Crossing meadow behind The Bull, for example

indicators.note: the meadow word goes behind the sign word

parts.note: Taurus, the Bull, is a sign of the zodiac
ing is a dialect word for a water meadow

explanation.surface: Crossing the field behind the pub called The Bull.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The Bull' sounds like a pub but is Taurus.
explanation.definitionFit: Making the sign of the cross, or a cross as one's mark on a document.
